title: Sanitised traffic event (one JSONL line)
description: One request/response pair after the sanitiser. Values are dropped; shapes remain. Spec-declared enum values may be kept, capped.

operation.description: Operation key 'METHOD /template' when the sanitiser matched locally against a supplied spec. Preferred: the raw path then never leaves the machine.

path.description: Path with value-like segments (digits, UUIDs, long hex, long tokens) replaced by '{*}'. Used when the sanitiser had no spec to match against.

client.description: hex(sha256(workspace_salt || identity_value))[0:16]. A pseudonym, not anonymisation. Absent when no client identity is configured.

salt_id.description: Identifies which salt hashed the client id; the salt itself never appears.

types.description: Types seen at this path within this one event (more than one when array elements differ).

values.description: Only for spec-declared enums; capped at 16. Never present for free-form fields.

truncated.description: True if the sanitiser hit the field-count (500) or depth (10) cap.
